name: B10-0221/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Azerbaijan to release jailed journalists, activists and researchers, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu. It asks the European Union to support independent media and civil society, to watch trials and visit prisoners, and to consider sanctions on named officials. It also says closer trade and energy ties should depend on releasing political prisoners and improving human rights.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Azerbaijan's government, jailed activists and journalists, and European Union officials.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union leaders and Azerbaijan's government; they decide whether to act.
